raw_segments.text: Trifon Borisovich looked apprehensively at Midia, but at once obediently did his bidding.
Leading him into the passage, he went himself into the first large room, adjoining that
in which the visitors were sitting, and took the light away.
Then he stealthily led Midia in, and put him in a corner in the dark, whence he could freely
watch the company without being seen.
But Midia did not look long, and indeed he could not see them he saw her.
His heart throbbed violently, and all was dark before his eyes.
